directorPosition: Director of Aktobe Higher Polytechnic College
greetingText1: Dear students, teachers, parents and partners! Welcome to the blog page of the Director of Aktobe Higher Polytechnic College.
greetingText2: Our college is a place where professionals are born. We create conditions for quality education, personal development and a successful career start for every student. Here you will find my thoughts on college life, important announcements and answers to your questions.
greetingText3: I am always open to dialogue. If you have questions, suggestions or wishes — use the form below. Together we make our college better!
faq1Question: How to enroll in Aktobe Higher Polytechnic College?
faq1Answer: To enroll, you need to submit documents to the admissions committee: a certificate of education, an identity document, a medical certificate (form 075-u) and 6 photos of 3×4. Document submission runs from June to August. More details can be found on the 'Admission Rules' page.
faq2Question: What specialties does the college offer?
faq2Answer: Our college offers more than 20 specialties in technical sciences, information technology, economics and law. The full list of specialties is available in the 'Specialties' section of the website.
faq3Question: Is dormitory provided for out-of-town students?
faq3Answer: Yes, our college has a comfortable dormitory for out-of-town students. The dormitory is equipped with everything necessary for living and studying. To move in, you need to submit an application to the student department.
faq4Answer: Students studying on a state educational grant receive a state scholarship. Named scholarships for high academic performance and active public activities are also provided.
faq5Question: How do college graduates find employment?
faq5Answer: The employment rate of our graduates is 95%. The college actively cooperates with leading enterprises of the region. Students undergo industrial internships at real enterprises, which facilitates subsequent employment.
faq6Question: Does the college have dual education?
faq6Answer: Yes, our college implements dual education programs together with large partner enterprises. This allows students to combine theoretical education with practical activities in production.
